entries.source: জাপানের খাবারের barcode scan করুন অথবা প্যাকেটের

entries.source: লিখে ingredient check করুন। সন্দেহজনক উপাদান থাকলে কারণসহ দেখাবে—তথ্য না থাকলে কখনোই অনুমান করে “Halal” বলবে না।
entries.target: Isulat ito at i-check ang ingredient. Kung may kahina-hinalang sangkap, ipapakita ito kasama ang dahilan — kung walang impormasyon, hindi ito manghuhula at magsasabing “Halal”.

entries.target: Buksan ang camera at itapat ito sa barcode

entries.source: ক্যামেরা permission শুধু scan করার সময় ব্যবহার হবে।
entries.target: Gagamitin lang ang pahintulot sa camera habang nag-i-scan.

entries.source: Product data Open Food Facts-এর open database থেকে নেওয়া হয়। Database-এ product না থাকলে ingredient text দিয়ে check করুন।
entries.target: Kinukuha ang product data mula sa open database ng Open Food Facts. Kung wala ang product sa database, i-check gamit ang ingredient text.
Listahan ng ingredient mula sa database

entries.source: Pork/pig-derived বা alcohol-related ingredient signal পাওয়া গেছে।
entries.target: May nakitang signal ng sangkap na mula sa baboy o may kaugnayan sa alcohol.

entries.source: Gelatin, emulsifier, shortening-এর মতো source-dependent ingredient।
entries.target: Mga sangkap na nakadepende sa pinagmulan, tulad ng gelatin, emulsifier at shortening.
Green — Walang malinaw na signal na nakita

entries.source: এটা Halal certification নয়; package/certifier দিয়ে final check করুন।
entries.target: Hindi ito Halal certification; gawin ang final check sa package/certifier.

entries.source: এই scanner ingredient text-এর rule-based screening করে; এটি কোনো মুফতি, halal certifier বা official certification-এর বিকল্প নয়। Recipe, supplier ও ingredient source বদলাতে পারে—সন্দেহ থাকলে প্যাকেটের certification এবং manufacturer-এর তথ্য যাচাই করুন। Product data community-maintained Open Food Facts থেকে আসে, তাই তথ্য অসম্পূর্ণ বা ভুল হতে পারে।
entries.target: Gumagawa ang scanner na ito ng rule-based screening ng ingredient text; hindi ito kapalit ng mufti, halal certifier o opisyal na sertipikasyon. Maaaring magbago ang recipe, supplier at pinagmulan ng sangkap — kung may pagdududa, i-verify ang sertipikasyon sa pakete at impormasyon ng manufacturer. Nagmumula ang product data sa community-maintained na Open Food Facts, kaya maaaring hindi kumpleto o mali ang impormasyon.
